source_findings.topic: Strict complete shard union and preserved prediction artifacts
source_findings.evidence: Merge requires all four actual markers and completed smoke-marked shard receipts; exact declared boundaries; ordered sequence records; fixed model/head epoch/root/dataset/action mode; no zero_init, parity, disabled search, unsafe writes, frame cap or validation subset. It checks visible and IR file counts against every prediction/receipt length, four prediction columns, finite boxes/latencies, positive n-1 latency arrays, and all prediction/latency/NPZ paths. The full union must contain exactly245/220703 or234/116649. Only then does it hard-link the same-filesystem per-sequence files into an absent aggregate root and set smoke_onlyFalse. source_findings.limit: Source fixtures checked control-flow metadata and shape/finite predicate doubles, not real NumPy data, hard-link IO or completed new shards. Detailed timeline internals are checked later by the unchanged mechanism collector.

source_findings.topic: Actual-GT metrics and collector field contracts
source_findings.evidence: Report script first requires the strict merge PASS. Aggregate config/completion keys satisfy collect_core_metrics and collect_recoverability_metrics. Core collector independently checks all actual GT against the native evaluator GT, exact counts/prediction shape and full receipts, then uses native NPR/PR/SR order for LasHeR and MPR/MSR for RGBT234. It writes per-sequence, all attributes and mean curves. Separate baseline and C1 two-variant reports feed unchanged paired_sequence_bootstrap defaults5000/seed42 and full curve/attribute plots. Mechanism collector receives direct prediction roots, reconciles runtime counters/timelines with actual GT and writes its own completion marker. Shell report_completed is written only after every collector/plot command succeeds.

source_findings.topic: New independent CPU native arithmetic audit
source_findings.evidence: audit_native_complete_cpu.py waits for report and mechanism markers, rechecks all3variants exact complete receipts/names/frame lengths, loads actual dataset GT and computes native metrics itself. Eight geometry expressions are AST-identical to the prior actual audit after only variable renaming: float32 round0 predictions, inclusive centers/IoU, LasHeR GT first row and existing invalid-GT mapping, RGBT234 minimum RGB/TIR errors and maximum overlap, equal sequence weighting. It checks every core sequence metric, all attributes, thresholds/curves and overall metrics exactly; both paired reports match core and both5000/seed42 CIs are independently reproduced. Metric function calls and NN calls are absent. Unrelated original fit/control/no-search assertions are correctly removed for the current3variant scope.
source_findings.limit: As in the prior accepted audit, noninitial rounded prediction widths/heights must be positive; failure rejects acceptance and does not silently change native protocol. Detailed mechanism mass recomputation is explicitly outside this focused arithmetic auditor. No actual new report was scored here.
